title: One-step characterization of remaining product bits
statement: Let $a,b,c$ be finite bit strings and let $j<|a|+|b|$. The following are equivalent: $|c|\le |a|+|b|$, the carry after $|a|+|b|$ columns is zero, and every position $i$ from $j$ through $|a|+|b|-1$ has bit of $c$ equal to the parity of the carry into column $i$ plus the sum of the bit products contributing to column $i$; or, the bit of $c$ at position $j$ equals that column’s parity and the same remaining-bit conditions hold from position $j+1$ onward.
